findings.description: is_palindrome() uses `s == s[::-1]` instead of comparing the cleaned string to its reverse (`cleaned == cleaned[::-1]`). This causes case-sensitive comparisons and includes spaces, so valid palindromes like 'A man a plan a canal Panama' return False.

fix_description: Change `return s == s[::-1]` to `return cleaned == cleaned[::-1]` so the palindrome comparison uses the lowercased, space-removed string instead of the original string. This ensures case-insensitive comparison and ignores spaces, making the test for 'A man a plan a canal Panama' pass.
